title: System-site isolation and path injection
summary: The include-system-site-packages setting controls one source of package visibility. Startup .pth files can add paths and execute code; activation merely changes shell environment and does not prove a running process uses a venv.
checks: Compare cfg isolation intent with its explicit contract.
Treat hooks, external package roots and actual process interpreter/path identity as separate evidence.
limitations: This module never evaluates .pth files, activation or target imports; isolation PASS covers only the cfg setting.
applicability: POSIX CPython venv metadata for Python 3.11-3.14; static evidence only
